Package com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp

package com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp
  • Class
    Description
    Oid
    An immutable numeric SNMP object identifier: an ordered sequence of non-negative sub-identifiers such as 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.1.0.
    OidFormatException
    Thrown when a textual object identifier cannot be parsed into an Oid — for example an empty string, a component that is not a non-negative decimal integer, or an empty component from a doubled dot (1..2).
    OidRegistry
    A small bundled registry that resolves numeric SNMP object identifiers to symbolic MIB names and back.
    SmiFormatter
    Renders SNMP/SMI values as human-readable display strings — the kind of formatting a MIB browser applies when it shows the result of a GET.
    SnmpService
    SNMP browser client over SNMP4J — community-based v1 / v2c GET and WALK (GETNEXT) over UDP, plus SNMPv3 / USM GET and WALK (SnmpService.getV3(com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp.SnmpV3Config, java.lang.String, java.lang.String...), SnmpService.walkV3(com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp.SnmpV3Config, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, int)).
    SnmpService.VarBind
    A decoded SNMP variable binding.
    SnmpTrapReceiver
    Listens on a UDP port (default 162) for incoming SNMP v1 / v2c traps and notifications over SNMP4J, decoding each into an immutable SnmpTrapReceiver.Trap record and delivering it to a registered listener.
    SnmpTrapReceiver.Trap
    A decoded SNMP trap / notification.
    SnmpV3Config
    A typed, validated SNMPv3 User-based Security Model (USM) configuration.
    SnmpV3Config.AuthProtocol
    USM authentication protocol.
    SnmpV3Config.PrivProtocol
    USM privacy (encryption) protocol.
    SnmpV3Config.SecurityLevel
    SNMPv3 message security level.
    SnmpV3Usm
    Pure mapper from a SnmpV3Config to the SNMP4J User-based Security Model (USM) primitives a v3 session needs: the authentication / privacy protocol OIDs, the SecurityLevel integer, and a localizable UsmUser.
    UsmPrivacy
    The privacy (encryption) half of the SNMPv3 User-based Security Model, complementing the auth-only UsmSecurity.
    UsmPrivacy.Encrypted
    The output of an encryption: the ciphertext plus the privParameters (the salt) that the peer needs — alongside the shared localized key and, for AES, the engine boots/time — to reconstruct the IV and decrypt.
    UsmPrivacy.PrivProtocol
    USM privacy protocol selector.
    UsmSecurity
    The cryptographic core of the SNMPv3 User-based Security Model (USM, RFC 3414).
    UsmSecurity.AuthProtocol
    USM authentication protocol — selects both the digest and the HMAC variant.

NexusLink — one console, every protocol, zero context switching.
